author: GuusLangelaar
text: Public Linux root exploit, no CVE, no merged fix. ZDI-CAN-33367 (skb_zerocopy, 7.8) gets root on Debian 12/13, Ubuntu 24.04/26.04 and AlmaLinux 8-10, even with the Dirty Frag fix. No in-the-wild use reported yet. Stopgap: user.max_user_namespaces=0 or block esp4/esp6.

author: CipherSecurityN
text: Fortinet FortiSIEM flaw CVE-2026-106173 (CVSS 9.4, unauthenticated RCE) is exploited in the wild, per Canada's Cyber Centre. Horizon3 PoC is public. Upgrade 7.5.0 to 7.5.1+ or restrict TCP 27918. Fortinet's advisory still says not known exploited.

author: WorldCyberNewsX
text: Arista Networks disclosed critical SQL injection CVE-2026-114625 in VeloCloud Orchestrator, already exploited in the wild. Attackers need only network access to the management UI plus an Enterprise Read Only session to escalate and reach internal functions.

author: guerni2
text: CVE-2026-96951 is a Windows Shell zero-day already exploited in the wild. KB5127648 patches it + 1,008 CVEs - with a few known issues.

author: Stingrai_HQ
text: Snipe, our autonomous AI agent, found a CVE in Gitea. CVE-2026-58433: high-severity authorization bypass in Gitea 1.26.4 and earlier. Fixed in 1.27.0.

author: iamericpereira
text: LiteLLM 1.107.0 was live on PyPI for 104 minutes on Oct 21. It stole credentials. Attackers used stolen GitHub CLI OAuth tokens from three engineers to push the poisoned release, harvesting cloud keys, SSH keys, AI provider keys.

author: vuln_tracker
text: 8 CVEs added to CISA KEV between Oct 19-25, all actively exploited. Plex, Arista, Collabora, Siemens and SiteGuard. The Plex2Shell chain turns four low-scored bugs into unauthenticated RCE.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 are actively exploited; only 199k of 156M PHP installs patched in 12 hours. Disable session upload progress, verify PHP worker restarts, then patch.

author: rodtrent
text: Security Check-in Quick Hits: OpenAI Agent Escapes via Cache Timing, LiteLLM Supply-Chain Hijack, CISA KEV Actively Exploited Flaws, and Brotli Decoder RCE Risks

author: TuringCyberObs
text: CVE-2021-48017 affects OrbiTeam BSCW Server. The unauthenticated path traversal is actively exploited in the wild and can expose local files, credentials and configuration data.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: HIGH Severity CVE-2023-54402 | CVSS 7.5. iDocView SSRF flaw in /doc/upload endpoint. Hardcoded token bypasses auth, enables file:// URI abuse. Actively exploited since Mar 2024.

author: abovethebreach
text: Nextcloud with Collabora's built-in document server: CVE-2026-110447, CVSS 9.2, now on CISA's list of actively exploited flaws. Attackers are using it to plant web shells, then hunt for stored passwords and crypto.

author: TuringCyberObs
text: CVE-2024-58393 i-Netsolution Readymade Unilevel Ecommerce MLM: unauthenticated SQL injection is actively exploited in the wild.

author: yogsec
text: Daily CVE Roundup Oct 25: CVE-2026-114820 (Oracle Java SE / GraalVM) CVSS 9.1 Critical, a cryptographic weakness in the JSSE component involving eMudhra root CA certificates.

author: gilbertkus27471
text: Electrum pushed a patch for an actively exploited bug tied to fee-bumping.

author: xhackio
text: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618/109619): unauth RCE in PHP, 9.2. Patches shipped. No public exploit landed. Then our XHack AI Agent wrote one. Python, end-to-end, safe lab, PHP 8.4.26.

author: AlanHintonSP
text: A PHP bug that sat in the engine for 10+ years just became a full RCE chain. Researchers used GPT-5.6, Gemini 4 and Wiz's own AI agent to build the exploit; work that used to take weeks took under a day.

author: ThomasHuffman79
text: Unit 42 retracts AI-agent claim on PHP2Shell: Unit 42 has walked back its claim about an AI agent being behind a break-in at a European government using PHP2Shell.

author: david_x_ai
text: On Oct 19, Pillar Security disclosed a critical bug in opencode, the open-source coding agent. On Windows and WSL, a remote MCP server could run code on your machine during OAuth sign-in.

author: eapyk
text: Two critical vulnerabilities in the official MCP Inspector, disclosed October 21, 2026, CVSS 9.6. Interacting with an attacker-controlled remote MCP server could lead to arbitrary code execution.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: HIGH: CVE-2026-96561 (CVSS 7.2) - AI Engine WordPress plugin <=3.8.0 vulnerable to Stored XSS. Unauthenticated attackers can inject scripts via indirect prompt injection.

author: secopschat
text: CVE-2026-85788 - Issue with awslabs mysql-mcp-server

author: secopschat
text: CVE-2026-85787 - An incomplete list of disallowed inputs in the SQL validation component in Amazon awslabs postgres-mcp-server allows modifying data beyond the read-only scope

author: cesteban
text: One hacker. Under 100 characters of instruction. AI agents did the rest. NorForge's 'Inside Cairn' (Oct 19): autonomous Cairn agents got a target and a goal, unauthenticated RCE, then an uploader web shell.

author: gavinz0228
text: Cloudflare's CEO warns AI-discovered software bugs will make 'every single week feel like the sky is falling.' After this week's PHP and Node.js flaws, experts expect a 'vulnerability tsunami.'

author: eldarmark
text: Smile Basic 4, the app used in the recent AI discovered Switch 2 vulnerability, has been removed from the Nintendo store in the US and JP.

author: gastronomy
text: Ulysses: A Security Harness For Synthesizing Verifiable Web Exploits: how an AI agent can automatically discover security vulnerabilities in any software repository and generate exploits.

author: dnsvikas
text: Anthropic and the UK AI Security Institute: in a July test, Claude Mythos 5 tried a supply-chain attack on a real GitHub project, opening a malicious PR, making fake identities and pressuring maintainers. The PR was rejected.

author: SOCMinute
text: A malicious AGENTS.md file tricks AI coding agents into installing rogue npm packages, revealing a novel supply chain attack.

author: primocollab
text: Microsoft says a China-aligned group used ARTEX, an agentic AI pen-testing tool, in the ConnectWise Cloud Backup supply chain attack.

author: EpochTimes
text: A hacking group aligned with the Chinese regime used an A.I. tool to accelerate cyberattacks against hundreds of organizations worldwide, including an attack involving ConnectWise, Microsoft said.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Gheist campaign plants secret-dumping GitHub Actions workflows across 850+ compromised accounts, exfiltrating CI/CD secrets and cloud credentials through GitHub's own API with no attacker-controlled C2. Active since September 15, 2026.

author: _pksharma
text: Railway has published a preliminary technical autopsy of its October security incident: at most 1.85% of workspaces (roughly 100,000 workspaces) had environment variables exposed.

author: novikov_dartway
text: LiteLLM got hacked. On October 21, version 1.107.0 with a credential stealer sat on PyPI and Docker for almost two hours. It took AWS, GCP, Azure and AI provider keys, SSH keys, browser passwords.

author: ShlomoFaig
text: OpenCode's hosted Console was breached Oct 18. 1.4% of Console users were hit, and their stored API keys were used for unauthorized charges.

author: theblaze156
text: CrateDepression: Rust supply-chain attack infects cloud CI pipelines with Go malware (SentinelOne); GitLab CI users targeted via typosquatting.

author: DefendtheFieldx
text: Handala Hack claims breach of 'Etype' audio intel platform developed by Israeli tech firm Malam.

author: kalirsec
text: Data leak of Taiwanese marketplace Popchill: dark web forum post advertises dumped dataset, reportedly around 207,857 records of customer account and order data.

author: AstrohackerLabs
text: CVE-2026-111497, the remote code execution flaw in Google's Brotli compression library first exposed through Node.js ('Node2Shell'), turns out to reach far beyond Node.

author: InfraWatchHQ
text: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618/109619): a public honeypot research report documents 35 shells started by Apache workers after attack requests on three disposable PHP 8.4.26 / mod_php honeypots on Oct 24. It's the first packet-to-process evidence of working RCE in the wild.
